description: One Task comment's copy on its GitHub Issue: the two identities, kept until both copies are gone. Comment sync work itself lives in the Issue link's delta and Retry Job rows.

fields.description: The Envision Comment's name. Plain data, so it outlives the Comment until its GitHub copy is deleted too.
fields.label: Comment

fields.description: The side the comment was written on.
fields.label: Written In

fields.description: GitHub's stable comment ID. Empty until Envision's create is confirmed.
fields.label: GitHub Comment ID

fields.description: Who wrote it on GitHub, for a comment written there. Empty for a deleted GitHub account.
fields.label: GitHub Author

fields.description: Random token in the GitHub copy's hidden trailer, so a create whose reply was lost can be found again.
fields.label: Create Marker

fields.description: Committed before a create is sent; cleared once the GitHub comment is known.
fields.label: Create Sent At

name: Envision GitHub Comment Sync
